"""Capture the declarative project and build its pure wheel twice in owned Temp."""

import contextlib
from email.parser import HeaderParser
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import sys
import time
import tomllib
import zipfile

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROJECT_SHA = "917fe7353178849ec9e7f53627fc0ce2e0be9fb7678d6dcd2e42f79b925de8f9"
INSPECTOR = REPO / "docs/poc/oracle9_wheels_inspect.py"
INSPECTOR_SHA = "2bbcfd531f3da5f39dc4c57e5c6b5e567c2f275c3a4f3452c2435cefc340285f"
SUMMARY = REPO / "docs/poc/evidence/oracle9-wheel-inspection-summary-20261026.json"
SUMMARY_SHA = "d2f0bfcae80e8e306a95942f360e98cd8f703a3c8fb33cf1a1c52054421fd213"
BACKEND_SHA = "6f4a583e1b6bb0d5ef3af2ac0a6e9a033d06f364e4a550e3b112812674b38419"
TOOLS = {"setuptools": "84.0.0", "wheel": "0.48.0", "packaging": "26.3"}


def need(value, category):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(category)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def regular(path):
    s = path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not getattr(s, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400, "SOURCE_FILE")


def capture(repo):
    """Read bytes without following any link; never copy the checkout root."""
    for directory in (repo, repo / "src"):
        ds = directory.lstat()
        need(
            stat.S_ISDIR(ds.st_mode)
            and not getattr(ds, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400
            and not stat.S_ISLNK(ds.st_mode),
            "SOURCE_DIRECTORY",
        )
    project = repo / "pyproject.toml"
    regular(project)
    need(project.stat().st_size <= 65536, "PROJECT_SIZE")
    files = {"pyproject.toml": project.read_bytes()}
    need(sha(files["pyproject.toml"]) == PROJECT_SHA, "PROJECT_CHANGED")
    config = tomllib.loads(files["pyproject.toml"].decode())
    need(
        config["build-system"]
        == {"requires": ["setuptools>=68"], "build-backend": "setuptools.build_meta"},
        "BACKEND",
    )
    need(
        not config["project"].get("dynamic")
        and config["project"]["name"] == "maskgw"
        and config["project"]["version"] == "0.1.0",
        "PROJECT_METADATA",
    )
    pending = [repo / "src/maskgw"]
    total = len(files["pyproject.toml"])
    while pending:
        directory = pending.pop()
        ds = directory.lstat()
        need(
            stat.S_ISDIR(ds.st_mode) and not getattr(ds, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400,
            "SOURCE_DIRECTORY",
        )
        for child in sorted(directory.iterdir()):
            s = child.lstat()
            need(
                not getattr(s, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400 and not stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode),
                "SOURCE_LINK",
            )
            if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
                if child.name != "__pycache__":
                    pending.append(child)
                continue
            need(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode), "SOURCE_SPECIAL")
            relative = child.relative_to(repo).as_posix()
            need(
                len(relative.encode()) <= 512 and not any(ord(c) < 32 for c in relative),
                "SOURCE_PATH",
            )
            allowed = child.suffix == ".py" or (
                child.parent == repo / "src/maskgw/admin/ui/assets"
                and child.suffix in (".html", ".js", ".css", ".json")
            )
            need(allowed and s.st_size <= 1024 * 1024, "SOURCE_ALLOWLIST")
            raw = child.read_bytes()
            need(len(raw) == s.st_size, "SOURCE_CHANGED")
            total += len(raw)
            need(total <= 16 * 1024 * 1024 and len(files) < 512, "SOURCE_BUDGET")
            files[relative] = raw
    need(len(files) >= 20, "SOURCE_INCOMPLETE")
    return dict(sorted(files.items())), config


def manifest(files):
    return [{"path": k, "bytes": len(v), "sha256": sha(v)} for k, v in files.items()]


def write_new(path, raw):
    with path.open("xb") as f:
        f.write(raw)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())


def copy_source(destination, files):
    destination.mkdir()
    for name, raw in files.items():
        path = destination / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        write_new(path, raw)
    need(all((destination / k).read_bytes() == v for k, v in files.items()), "COPY_CHANGED")


class BoundedLog(io.StringIO):
    bytes_written = 0

    def write(self, text):
        self.bytes_written += len(text.encode("utf-8"))
        need(self.bytes_written <= 1024 * 1024, "BUILD_LOG_LIMIT")
        return super().write(text)


def minimal_environment(root):
    env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("SystemRoot", "WINDIR") if k in os.environ}
    env.update(
        {
            "TEMP": str(root / "tmp"),
            "TMP": str(root / "tmp"),
            "HOME": str(root / "home"),
            "USERPROFILE": str(root / "home"),
            "PATH": str(Path(sys.executable).parent)
            + os.pathsep
            + str(Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32"),
            "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH": "315532800",
            "PIP_NO_INDEX": "1",
            "PIP_CONFIG_FILE": os.devnull,
            "SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS": "local",
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        }
    )
    return env


def run_backend(source, output, root):
    """Public PEP517 hook of the installed, pinned backend, no frontend child."""
    output.mkdir()
    before, environment = Path.cwd(), dict(os.environ)
    log = BoundedLog()
    clean = minimal_environment(root)
    try:
        os.environ.clear()
        os.environ.update(clean)
        os.chdir(source)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(log), contextlib.redirect_stderr(log):
            from setuptools.build_meta import build_wheel

            filename = build_wheel(str(output))
        need(filename == "maskgw-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl", "WHEEL_NAME")
        need({v.name for v in output.iterdir()} == {filename}, "BUILD_OUTPUT")
        return output / filename, log.getvalue().encode("utf-8")
    finally:
        os.chdir(before)
        os.environ.clear()
        os.environ.update(environment)
        write_new(root / (source.name + "-backend.log"), log.getvalue().encode("utf-8"))


def validate_own_wheel(path, files, config, inspector):
    from packaging.requirements import Requirement

    regular(path)
    need(path.stat().st_size <= 8 * 1024 * 1024, "WHEEL_SIZE")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    stream = io.BytesIO(raw)
    _, count = inspector["central_preflight"](stream)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(stream) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        need(len(names) == count, "WHEEL_ENTRY_COUNT")
        expected = {k.removeprefix("src/") for k in files if k != "pyproject.toml"}
        need(len(names) == len(set(names)), "WHEEL_DUPLICATE")
        metadata_files = {
            "maskgw-0.1.0.dist-info/" + k for k in ("METADATA", "WHEEL", "RECORD", "top_level.txt")
        }
        need(set(names) == expected | metadata_files, "WHEEL_EXACT_MEMBERS")
        need(
            {v for v in names if not v.startswith("maskgw-0.1.0.dist-info/")} == expected,
            "WHEEL_MEMBERS",
        )
        for name in expected:
            need(archive.getinfo(name).file_size == len(files["src/" + name]), "WHEEL_SOURCE_SIZE")
            need(archive.read(name) == files["src/" + name], "WHEEL_SOURCE_BYTES")
        need(
            archive.getinfo("maskgw-0.1.0.dist-info/METADATA").file_size <= 1024 * 1024,
            "OWN_METADATA_SIZE",
        )
        meta = HeaderParser().parsestr(archive.read("maskgw-0.1.0.dist-info/METADATA").decode())
        actual_requires = meta.get_all("Requires-Dist", [])
        expected_requires = list(config["project"]["dependencies"])
        for extra, requirements in config["project"].get("optional-dependencies", {}).items():
            need(extra == "dev", "PROJECT_EXTRA")
            expected_requires.extend(r + '; extra == "dev"' for r in requirements)
        need(
            {Requirement(v) for v in actual_requires}
            == {Requirement(v) for v in expected_requires},
            "WHEEL_REQUIREMENTS",
        )
        need(meta.get_all("Provides-Extra", []) == ["dev"], "WHEEL_EXTRAS")
        need("maskgw-0.1.0.dist-info/entry_points.txt" not in names, "OWN_ENTRYPOINTS")
    entry = {
        "name": "maskgw",
        "version": "0.1.0",
        "filename": path.name,
        "sha256": sha(raw),
        "requires_python": config["project"]["requires-python"],
        "requires_dist": actual_requires,
    }
    result = inspector["inspect_wheel"](path, entry, time.monotonic() + 30)
    need(
        not result["pth_unapproved"]
        and not result["scripts"]
        and not result["entry_points"]
        and not any(v["elf"] or v["native_path"] for v in result["members"]),
        "OWN_WHEEL_SURFACE",
    )
    return result


def load_inspector():
    regular(INSPECTOR)
    source = INSPECTOR.read_bytes()
    need(sha(source) == INSPECTOR_SHA, "INSPECTOR_CHANGED")
    ns = {"__name__": "_pinned_inspector", "__file__": str(INSPECTOR)}
    exec(compile(source, str(INSPECTOR), "exec"), ns)
    return ns


def main(root):
    need(os.name == "nt" and sys.flags.isolated and not sys.flags.optimize, "RUNTIME")
    need(
        root.parent.resolve() == (Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Temp").resolve()
        and root.name.startswith("maskgw-oracle9-app-wheel-"),
        "OUTPUT_ROOT",
    )
    s = root.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and not getattr(s, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400, "OUTPUT_ROOT")
    regular(root / "state.json")
    need(
        (root / "state.json").stat().st_size <= 1024 * 1024
        and {v.name for v in root.iterdir()} == {"state.json"},
        "OUTPUT_NOT_FRESH",
    )
    state = json.loads((root / "state.json").read_bytes())
    need(
        state["invoked"] is False
        and state["kind"] == "oracle9-app-wheel-v1"
        and state["program_sha256"] == sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        "STATE",
    )
    write_new(root / "invoked.json", b'{"invoked":true}\n')
    regular(SUMMARY)
    need(SUMMARY.stat().st_size <= 1024 * 1024, "SUMMARY_SIZE")
    summary = SUMMARY.read_bytes()
    need(
        sha(summary) == SUMMARY_SHA
        and json.loads(summary)["outcome"] == "WHEELS_INSPECTED_STRUCTURALLY",
        "I_NOT_READY",
    )
    inspector = load_inspector()
    native_files, _manifest, _admission = inspector["admission"](Path(state["wheelhouse"]))
    need({k: importlib.metadata.version(k) for k in TOOLS} == TOOLS, "BUILD_TOOLS")
    backend = Path(
        importlib.metadata.distribution("setuptools").locate_file("setuptools/build_meta.py")
    )
    regular(backend)
    need(sha(backend.read_bytes()) == BACKEND_SHA, "BUILD_BACKEND")
    files, config = capture(REPO)
    from packaging.requirements import Requirement

    need(
        {inspector["canonical"](Requirement(v).name) for v in config["project"]["dependencies"]}
        == {v["name"] for v in native_files if v["requested"]},
        "RESOLVED_ROOTS",
    )
    need(manifest(files) == state["source_manifest"], "SOURCE_CHANGED")
    write_new(
        root / "source-manifest.json", (json.dumps(manifest(files), sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    )
    (root / "tmp").mkdir()
    (root / "home").mkdir()
    outputs, reports = [], []
    for index in (1, 2):
        source = root / ("source" + str(index))
        copy_source(source, files)
        path, log = run_backend(source, root / ("wheel" + str(index)), root)
        need(
            len(log) <= 1024 * 1024
            and all((source / k).read_bytes() == v for k, v in files.items()),
            "BUILD_SOURCE_CHANGED",
        )
        reports.append(validate_own_wheel(path, files, config, inspector))
        outputs.append(path)
        need(manifest(capture(REPO)[0]) == state["source_manifest"], "CHECKOUT_CHANGED")
    need(outputs[0].read_bytes() == outputs[1].read_bytes(), "NONDETERMINISTIC_WHEEL")
    result = {
        "kind": "oracle9-app-wheel-result-v1",
        "outcome": "APP_WHEEL_BUILT_VERIFIED",
        "task": state["task"],
        "program_sha256": state["program_sha256"],
        "project_sha256": PROJECT_SHA,
        "tools": TOOLS,
        "backend_sha256": BACKEND_SHA,
        "wheel_sha256": sha(outputs[0].read_bytes()),
        "wheel_bytes": outputs[0].stat().st_size,
        "source_manifest": manifest(files),
        "inspection": reports[0],
        "two_builds_identical": True,
        "installed": False,
    }
    write_new(root / "result.json", (json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode())
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                k: result[k]
                for k in ("outcome", "wheel_sha256", "wheel_bytes", "two_builds_identical")
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main(Path(sys.argv[1]))
    except Exception as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"outcome": "APP_WHEEL_REFUSED", "category": type(exc).__name__}))
        raise SystemExit(1) from None

"""Source capture and synthetic own-wheel checks; never invokes the real backend."""

import base64
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import types
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from packaging.requirements import Requirement

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@pytest.fixture
def builder() -> Any:
    path = REPO / "docs/poc/oracle9_app_wheel.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_app_builder_under_test", path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def fake_source(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    repo = tmp_path / "source-repo"
    package = repo / "src/maskgw"
    package.mkdir(parents=True)
    (repo / "pyproject.toml").write_bytes((REPO / "pyproject.toml").read_bytes())
    (package / "__init__.py").write_bytes(b"raise AssertionError('do not import source')\r\n")
    for index in range(20):
        (package / f"file{index}.py").write_bytes(f"VALUE = {index}\r\n".encode())
    return repo


def synthetic_wheel(path: Path, files: dict[str, bytes], config: Any, bad: str = "") -> None:
    dist = "maskgw-0.1.0.dist-info/"
    values = {k.removeprefix("src/"): v for k, v in files.items() if k != "pyproject.toml"}
    requires = list(config["project"]["dependencies"])
    requires.extend(
        r + '; extra == "dev"' for r in config["project"]["optional-dependencies"]["dev"]
    )
    if bad == "requires":
        requires.pop()
    metadata = (
        "Metadata-Version: 2.4\nName: maskgw\nVersion: 0.1.0\n"
        "Requires-Python: >=3.11\nProvides-Extra: dev\n"
    )
    metadata += "".join("Requires-Dist: " + str(Requirement(v)) + "\n" for v in requires)
    values[dist + "METADATA"] = metadata.encode() + b"\n"
    values[dist + "WHEEL"] = b"Wheel-Version: 1.0\nRoot-Is-Purelib: true\nTag: py3-none-any\n\n"
    values[dist + "top_level.txt"] = b"maskgw\n"
    if bad == "extra":
        values[".env"] = b"must-never-be-packaged"
    elif bad == "bytes":
        values["maskgw/__init__.py"] = b"x" * len(values["maskgw/__init__.py"])
    elif bad == "missing":
        del values["maskgw/__init__.py"]
    elif bad == "entrypoint":
        values[dist + "entry_points.txt"] = b"[console_scripts]\nmaskgw = maskgw:main\n"
    rows = []
    for name, raw in values.items():
        digest = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
        rows.append(f"{name},sha256={digest},{len(raw)}\n")
    values[dist + "RECORD"] = ("".join(rows) + dist + "RECORD,,\n").encode()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w", compression=8) as archive:
        for name, raw in values.items():
            archive.writestr(name, raw)


def test_capture_is_byte_exact_no_checkout_mutation(tmp_path, builder):
    repo = fake_source(tmp_path)
    files, config = builder.capture(repo)
    assert len(files) == 22 and config["project"]["name"] == "maskgw"
    assert files["src/maskgw/__init__.py"].endswith(b"\r\n")
    assert all(not name.startswith((".venv", ".git", ".codex")) for name in files)
    destination = tmp_path / "captured"
    builder.copy_source(destination, files)
    assert all((destination / name).read_bytes() == raw for name, raw in files.items())
    assert builder.capture(repo)[0] == files


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["project", "config", "unknown", "large", "link"])
def test_source_fail_closed_on_changed_project_or_unknown_file(tmp_path, builder, bad):
    repo = fake_source(tmp_path)
    package = repo / "src/maskgw"
    if bad == "project":
        with (repo / "pyproject.toml").open("ab") as f:
            f.write(b"\n")
    elif bad == "large":
        (package / "large.py").write_bytes(b"x" * (1024 * 1024 + 1))
    elif bad == "link":
        try:
            (package / "link.py").symlink_to(package / "__init__.py")
        except OSError:
            pytest.skip("symlink privilege not available")
    else:
        (package / ("settings.yaml" if bad == "config" else ".private")).write_bytes(b"private")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        builder.capture(repo)


def test_cache_is_skipped_but_other_directory_is_not_ignored(tmp_path, builder):
    repo = fake_source(tmp_path)
    cache = repo / "src/maskgw/__pycache__"
    cache.mkdir()
    (cache / "generated.pyc").write_bytes(b"ignored-cache")
    files, _ = builder.capture(repo)
    assert all("__pycache__" not in name for name in files)
    private = repo / "src/maskgw/private"
    private.mkdir()
    (private / "catalog.json").write_bytes(b"must-not-package")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="SOURCE_ALLOWLIST"):
        builder.capture(repo)


def test_assets_only_at_declared_package_location(tmp_path, builder):
    repo = fake_source(tmp_path)
    assets = repo / "src/maskgw/admin/ui/assets"
    assets.mkdir(parents=True)
    (assets / "ui.js").write_bytes(b"public asset")
    files, _ = builder.capture(repo)
    assert files["src/maskgw/admin/ui/assets/ui.js"] == b"public asset"
    (repo / "src/maskgw/private.js").write_bytes(b"private")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        builder.capture(repo)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["", "requires", "extra", "bytes", "missing", "entrypoint"])
def test_own_wheel_matches_source_bytes_and_all_requirements(tmp_path, builder, bad):
    files, config = builder.capture(fake_source(tmp_path))
    path = tmp_path / "maskgw-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl"
    synthetic_wheel(path, files, config, bad)
    if bad:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            builder.validate_own_wheel(path, files, config, builder.load_inspector())
    else:
        result = builder.validate_own_wheel(path, files, config, builder.load_inspector())
        assert result["name"] == "maskgw" and not result["entry_points"]
        assert len(result["metadata"]["requires_dist"]) == 14


def test_minimal_environment_never_inherits_secrets(monkeypatch, tmp_path, builder):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MASKGW_TEST_DSN", "private-canary")
    monkeypatch.setenv("HTTPS_PROXY", "private-canary")
    monkeypatch.setenv("PYTHONPATH", "private-canary")
    env = builder.minimal_environment(tmp_path)
    assert "private-canary" not in json.dumps(env)
    assert env["SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"] == "315532800" and env["PIP_NO_INDEX"] == "1"


def test_backend_logs_are_bounded_in_encoded_bytes(builder):
    log = builder.BoundedLog()
    log.write("a" * (1024 * 1024 - 1))
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="BUILD_LOG_LIMIT"):
        log.write("é")
    assert len(log.getvalue().encode()) < 1024 * 1024


@pytest.mark.parametrize("fail", [False, True])
def test_fake_backend_restores_environment_cwd_and_keeps_logs(monkeypatch, tmp_path, builder, fail):
    source, output = tmp_path / "source1", tmp_path / "wheel1"
    source.mkdir()
    original_cwd, original_env = Path.cwd(), dict(os.environ)
    monkeypatch.setenv("MASKGW_FAKE_SECRET", "private-canary")
    backend: Any = types.ModuleType("setuptools.build_meta")

    def fake_hook(destination):
        assert Path.cwd() == source and "MASKGW_FAKE_SECRET" not in os.environ
        assert os.environ["SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"] == "315532800"
        print("public fake backend log")
        if fail:
            raise RuntimeError("fake backend failure")
        name = "maskgw-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl"
        (Path(destination) / name).write_bytes(b"fake-wheel-no-import")
        return name

    backend.build_wheel = fake_hook
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "setuptools.build_meta", backend)
    if fail:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="fake backend failure"):
            builder.run_backend(source, output, tmp_path)
    else:
        path, log = builder.run_backend(source, output, tmp_path)
        assert path.name.endswith(".whl") and b"fake backend log" in log
    assert Path.cwd() == original_cwd
    assert os.environ["MASKGW_FAKE_SECRET"] == "private-canary"  # noqa: S105 -- leak-test canary.
    assert all(os.environ[k] == v for k, v in original_env.items() if k != "MASKGW_FAKE_SECRET")
    assert b"public fake backend log" in (tmp_path / "source1-backend.log").read_bytes()


def test_zip_preflight_before_unbounded_central_directory(builder):
    inspector = builder.load_inspector()
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        inspector["central_preflight"](io.BytesIO(b"not-a-zip"))
